name: card-grid-auto-fit
title: Card Grid Auto Fit
description: Responsive auto-fitting CSS grid layout that dynamically adjusts column counts based on minimum card width.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Fluid Autofit Wrapping: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
